summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing of Emergent Upsell CRM. 22/22 backend pytest cases passed covering auth, RBAC, leads CRUD, assignment + round-robin, notes, CSV import, meetings + outcomes, Stripe link creation, Razorpay simulate, campaigns send, dashboard (admin+agent), audit log. UI verified via Playwright: admin/agent login, role-based nav (admin sees Campaigns/Team/Audit; agent does NOT), KPI dashboard, lead create, lead detail panels (account context, stage-select, priority-select), notes, book meeting (stage -> Meeting Scheduled), pipeline kanban columns, payments page totals, meetings outcome (stage -> Meeting Completed), campaign create + send, team add agent, audit log entries.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is single-file ~830 lines and contains all routes, models, helpers, and seed logic. Consider modularising (routers per resource, services/, models/) once the app grows further.
_round_robin_agent() uses a global counter without a tenant scope; OK for single-org MVP but flag for multi-tenant.

Stripe webhook endpoint (/api/webhook/stripe) is publicly mounted (no auth dep) which is correct; ensure STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET verification is enforced inside emergentintegrations.handle_webhook (cannot verify from server.py).
CORS allow_origins defaults to '*' with allow_credentials=True — browsers will reject credentialed requests with wildcard; restrict origins via CORS_ORIGINS env in production.
list_leads returns up to 2000 docs without pagination; will degrade with scale.
Meetings list endpoint always returns up to 1000 results; consider pagination.
_apply_payment_status sets lead.stage='Won' on paid for both Stripe and Razorpay — good; consider also setting payment_status='paid' in lead doc (already done) — verified.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all flows verified except a flaky pay-modal open in one back-to-back UI run; backend Stripe + lead-stage transition verified independently)

test_credentials: leader@emergent.com / leader123 (admin); sofia@emergent.com / agent123 (agent). Loaded from /app/memory/test_credentials.md.
seed_data_creation: App auto-seeds 1 admin + 3 agents + 8 leads + 4 meetings today on startup. Tests created TEST_* prefixed leads/agents/campaigns; no destructive teardown but uses unique timestamps to avoid collisions.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Lead detail navigation requires clicking the lead-name <Link> (a[href^='/leads/']), not the row itself. Lead detail testids: stage-select, priority-select, note-input, add-note-btn, book-meeting-btn, meet-datetime, confirm-meeting-btn, send-payment-btn, pay-provider, pay-package, pay-amount, generate-payment-btn. After book-meeting, opening pay modal in the same run can occasionally race; refresh the page between modals if testing both.
rca of the issue: N/A — no critical defects found. Stripe link generation returns a real cs_test_* URL via emergentintegrations; Razorpay simulate marks payment paid and advances lead to Won; role-based nav correctly hides Campaigns/Team/Audit for agents.
